categories.name: Pricing
questions: Yes. Transfert is being built to be completely free — no subscription, no premium plan, no per-file charge.
No. The idea is that you can convert your files without any account.
Will the code be open source?
Yes. The desktop app will be open source under the MIT or Apache-2.0 licenses.

categories.name: Privacy
questions: Do my files go to a server?
No. Transfert is designed to process your files on your own device. Conversion and metadata editing will be local — no content ever leaves your machine.
Metadata is information attached to a file — GPS location, camera model, author, creation date. Transfert will let you inspect, edit or remove supported fields before sharing.

categories.name: Features
questions: The project plans to support images, video, audio, documents and archives. The exact list of formats and conversions will be confirmed as the processing engine is built. The formats shown in the demo are illustrative.
Can I convert multiple files at once?
That's the plan. You'll be able to apply conversions and adjustments to multiple files at once, with presets for your workflow.

categories.name: Launch
questions: Can I download the app now?
Not yet. The desktop app is in development and there is no public version available for download. This page presents the concept and an interactive demo, not a working converter.
Not confirmed yet. Supported platforms will be defined as development progresses.

downloadPage.pageDescription: Download the Transfert desktop app for macOS and Windows.
downloadPage.description: Transfert is a desktop app that converts, strips metadata, and packages your files locally — no cloud, no account. Download links will appear here when the first version ships.
downloadPage.footnote: Will be open source under MIT or Apache-2.0 — build from source or grab a pre-built binary when it ships.

privacyPage.pageDescription: Transfert collects no personal data. No tracking, no analytics, no account required.
privacyPage.callout: Short version: Transfert collects nothing about you. We do not sell, share or monetise any data — because we do not have any.
privacyPage.websiteStatic: This website is static and informational. It does not use cookies, analytics, tracking pixels or advertising scripts of any kind.
privacyPage.websiteHosting: The site is hosted on <vercel>Vercel</vercel>. As part of their infrastructure, Vercel may log standard HTTP access data — such as IP addresses and request timestamps — at the edge network level. This is handled entirely by Vercel, we do not access or store this data ourselves. You can read more in <vercelPrivacy>Vercel's privacy policy</vercelPrivacy>.
privacyPage.desktopIntro: Transfert is designed to work entirely on your device. This is a core principle of the project, not a setting.
desktopPoints: Your files are never uploaded to any server.
No account is required to use the application.
No usage data, telemetry or crash reports are collected.
No third-party analytics or advertising SDKs are included.
